WatchHomePromo.title: Message eo ejjab ukōt. Wāween an armej lale ej ukōt.
WatchHomePromo.description: Kōmman e video library im tools eo an jōtkob ir jān ijo, kōjbarok decades in translation work n̄an platforms eo armij ewor ijo kōnono, watch, im share.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Library in film eo eḷaptata an ukōte ilo laḷ in
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Decades in translation work, carried by trusted ministry partners, e kōmman juon library ewōr thousands of language tracks n̄an armej ro maron kwaḷḷañ story eo an Jesus ilo language eo e lōmṇak ilo ko c.

WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ej juon global team in translators, media specialists, editors, im creators eo rej kōmman decades in ministry experience n̄an tools n̄an disciple-makers ilo kajoor.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Connect viewers im opportunities tangible ilo spiritual journey eo, jipan ir n̄an bōk juon step elaplok ilo community, Scripture, ak mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Juon Christian media library elap ewōr videos, films, im resources ilo language ko ewor n̄an ministry im evangelism ilo world.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, im analytics eo kōn jipan ministries n̄an reach ppl ilo maron.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Jipan kōm build <highlight>the next generation</highlight> of mission tools
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Kōm invitation practitioner ro, creators, im partners n̄an early access. Test tools eo kapen, jipan feedback, im kōjbarok products eo kōmman n̄an real mission work.
